about: Template library categories. Add a category or subcategory here (no code changes) and the library builds original, editable templates for it from the layout system. Fields: id (unique, lowercase), label, emoji (motif shown in designs), keywords (search words), palettes (preferred palette ids from palettes.ts, optional), events (2-4 starter texts: title, kicker, details[2], cta, occasion). Optional "generate": false keeps a topic in the menus without building templates for it (for topics only made by hand or published from the template manager).
